text:
Assistant A correctly parsed the provided stock records and computed the maximum and minimum closing prices for each month present in the data (January, February, March), presenting them in a clear CSV format with one line per month. The values are accurate: for January the closes were 153.80 and 156.25 (high 156.25, low 153.80), for February 161.80 and 163.90 (high 163.90, low 161.80), and for March 166.80 and 168.20 (high 168.20, low 166.80). Assistant B, by contrast, provided only an introductory sentence and failed to include any actual data or results, making it unhelpful and incomplete.

[[A]]
